steps.title: Layout controls as sliders and horizontal choices
steps.caption: The weighted-tree example is paused and its measured labels separated with the shipped readability command. RFC settings use sliders with live values. Short choices use horizontal radio groups; large example/substructure inventories keep menus. These are presentation controls over the existing graph and configuration owners.

steps.title: Search methods, metrics and result limits
steps.caption: Lexical/LDA and term/tag choices are directly visible. The LDA metric names remain available to assistive technology and on hover. An unchecked custom-distance limit retains the engine defaults; selecting a metric or moving a slider keeps the existing retrieval boundary.

steps.title: Topic-model settings remain local and inspectable
steps.caption: Topics, passes, random seed, vocabulary frequency and priors use sliders and live values. Wide magnitude ranges use logarithmic scales; integer arrows retain exact increments, including the random seed. The graph is not searched or retrained for this control demonstration.

steps.title: Retract the controls and keep the document
steps.caption: Controls hides the panel and gives the graph its width. Settings, open sections and scroll position remain available when it reopens; quick search reveals its query field. Collapsing changes viewport geometry, preserving physical node coordinates and semantic data. The preference is session-only.
